messages:
Priya Menon: FYI  weve got an afternoon onsite candidate next Fri (June 2). Candidate is using the company shuttle from SFO and needs wheelchair-accessible route from loading dock to 3rd floor. Also requested halal lunch and a Spanish interpreter on-site. Can facilities/security/cafe coordinate? :raised_hands:

Sam Patel: Thanks Priya. Candidate details? shuttle arrival time? contact? dietary note documented?

Priya Menon: Candidate: Amina Siddiqui, mobile +1-628-555-0147. Shuttle ETA 12:40pm at Loading Bay C. Company covers $25 ground transit if taxi used instead. Amina marked halal and low fragrance preference. Interpreter requested for 13:00can we confirm availability?

Taylor Ng: @Priya Menon adding to calendar. Reserving Quiet Room C (3rd floor) for prep and interview panel 12:5013:50. I can book a brief 15m interpreter slot at 13:00. Do you want a printed name badge or a lanyard?

Facilities Bot: Quiet Room C reserved (3rd floor) 12:3015:00. Wheelchair ramp route from Loading Bay C to 3rd-floor elevator confirmed. Volunteer escort will meet shuttle and escort candidate to security desk by 12:45. Ramp width checked.

Security Desk: Visitor badge printed under "Amina Siddiqui". ID required at check-in. Loading Bay C pickup: security staff will radio escort to elevator at 12:42. Note: temporary door propping allowed for accessibility by escort only.

Cafe Team: Halal boxed lunch ordered (grilled chicken salad + fruit cup). Low-fragrance packaging requested. Lunch to be delivered to Quiet Room C at 12:55. Please confirm any allergies.

Sam Patel: Allergies? Priya, do we know? Also can somebody confirm the interpreter name and whether remote is acceptable? If remote, I'll DM the Zoom token and dial-in backup.

Priya Menon: No allergies listed. Interpreter: we have Rosario (in-person) confirmed 12:5013:10. If Rosario is running late, remote backup is Ana (Spanish) via Zoom. Sam, please include Zoom fallback in DM. Candidate phone again +1-628-555-0147.

Taylor Ng: Noted. I'll add Zoom fallback: https://zoom.redwood-inc/room-fallback and pin a printed schedule in the room. Can Facilities leave a small desk lamp (low light) and a sensory-free sign? Candidate prefers low-light/quiet.

Facilities Bot: Lamp placed in Quiet Room C. Sensory sign printed and laminated. AV: laptop HDMI not required; interpreter will use conference laptop. Meeting table cleared.

Priya Menon: Run-of-day (short):
```
12:40  Shuttle arrives Loading Bay C
12:42  Security escort to elevator
12:45  Badge check-in (Security Desk)
12:50  Quiet Room prep + interpreter check
13:00  Panel interview start (3x30m with 10m breaks)
14:10  Wrap + candidate questions
14:20  Candidate leaves / debrief notes
```
Fallback contact: Priya Menon +1-415-555-0120. Shuttle coordinator: ops-shuttle@redwood.com

Security Desk: Will SMS Priya when shuttle lands and again at badge pickup. Badge pickup desk staffed by Zoe from 12:3015:00.

Cafe Team: Lunch delivery scheduled. If candidate indicates vegetarian instead, we'll swap to grilled halloumi salad.

Sam Patel: Great. I'll DM Amina the calendar invite, Zoom fallback, and shuttle pickup details. Tagging @Facilities Bot & @Security Desk  thanks everyone :pray:
